name: Post-Deployment Monitoring & Optimization

tasks.content: Implement comprehensive monitoring for Edge Function performance, data API response times, and Tavus conversation metrics.
Set up error tracking and alerting for tool failures, SSE connection drops, and voice pipeline interruptions.
Implement analytics to track conversation patterns, most requested information, and user interaction flows for optimization insights.
Analyze production metrics and optimize based on real usage patterns. Focus on tool response times and SSE stream efficiency.
Implement feedback collection mechanism for conference attendees to report issues or suggest improvements.
Prepare scaling strategies for peak conference periods (1000+ concurrent users during SnT2025 event).

research_topics: Vercel Edge Function monitoring best practices
